newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady amid thin activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady amid thin activity.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were unchanged Thursday amid light activity on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none Wednesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, week of Aug 10, bid 100 percent of tariff, unchanged from Wednesday, offer 110 percent, unchanged from Wednesday.
- Four barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of Aug 3 and Aug 10, bid 120 percent, no comparison, offer 125 percent, no comparison.
- Six barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of Aug 17-31, bid 130 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of Aug 10-31, no bid, offer 130 percent, no comparison.
